rules.quote: Single-agent runs can use the default project name.

rules.quote: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e down -v
rules.rule: To start e2e tests with a fresh database, run `docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e down -v` between runs.

rules.quote: Requires the dev stack (sqlserver + api + frontend) to be running locally.
rules.rule: Before running individual e2e tests outside Docker with `npx playwright test`, make sure the dev stack (sqlserver, api, frontend) is running locally.

rules.quote: Tests decorated with `[SkipIfNoClaudeApiKey]` are **opt-in only**
rules.rule: Do not run tests decorated with `[SkipIfNoClaudeApiKey]` by default; they run only when explicitly opted in.

rules.quote: $env:AI_INTEGRATION_TESTS = "1"; dotnet test --project backend/LangTeach.Api.Tests
rules.rule: To run AI integration tests locally, set the environment variable `AI_INTEGRATION_TESTS` to `1` before running `dotnet test` on the backend test project.

rules.quote: All AI integration tests use `ClaudeModel.Haiku` regardless of the production model
rules.rule: Use `ClaudeModel.Haiku` in all AI integration tests, regardless of the production model.

rules.quote: dotnet user-secrets set "Claude:ApiKey" "sk-ant-..."
rules.rule: Store the Claude API key in .NET user secrets with `dotnet user-secrets set "Claude:ApiKey"`.

rules.quote: never committed to the repo
rules.rule: Never commit the Claude API key to the repository.

rules.quote: Every issue gets exactly ONE priority label.
rules.rule: Give every issue exactly one priority label (P0:blocker, P1:must, P2:should, or P3:nice).

rules.quote: Every issue gets at least ONE area label.
rules.rule: Give every issue at least one area label.

rules.quote: `bug` or `enhancement` are optional type classifiers.
rules.rule: Treat the bug and enhancement labels as optional type classifiers; applying them is not required.

rules.quote: `qa:ready` is added by the QA reviewer agent (or manually) after acceptance criteria pass review.
rules.rule: Do not add the qa:ready label yourself; only the QA reviewer agent or a human adds it, after the acceptance criteria pass review.

rules.quote: `demo-sprint` is added to issues scoped into the current demo checkpoint.
rules.rule: Add the demo-sprint label only to issues scoped into the current demo checkpoint.

rules.quote: Drop everything.
rules.rule: When an issue is labeled P0:blocker, drop everything else and work on it.

rules.quote: Must be done before milestone closes.
rules.rule: Complete P1:must issues before their milestone closes.

rules.quote: Do if time allows within the milestone, otherwise rolls to next.
rules.rule: Work on P2:should issues only if time allows within the milestone; otherwise defer them to the next milestone.

rules.quote: Agent can pick this up.
rules.rule: The agent may pick up issues labeled qa:ready.

rules.quote: Bot MUST call Sophy as Step 0 of review routing, regardless of diff content.
rules.rule: For a PR whose issue has the review:sophy label, call Sophy as Step 0 of review routing, regardless of the diff content.

rules.quote: Applied to any issue where implementation could add hardcoded rules (if/else on language/level/template/L1) that belong in `data/` config instead.
rules.rule: Apply the review:sophy label to any issue where the implementation could add hardcoded rules (if/else on language, level, template, or L1) that belong in data/ config instead.

rules.quote: Still exists on old issues but no longer added to new ones.
rules.rule: Do not add the deprecated sprint:active label to new issues.

rules.quote: Task plan files must be written inside the active worktree
rules.rule: Write task plan files inside the active worktree, not in the main repo directory.

rules.quote: not in the main repo directory
rules.rule: Do not write task plan files in the main repo directory.

rules.quote: Never save plans directly in the root `plan\` folder
rules.rule: Never save plan files directly in the root `plan\` folder.

rules.quote: Feature subfolder per phase
rules.rule: Place each phase's plan files in a feature subfolder for that phase.

rules.quote: Phase overview: `plan.md` inside the subfolder
rules.rule: Name the phase overview file `plan.md` and place it inside the phase's subfolder.

rules.quote: Individual task files: `task<N>-<short-description>.md` in the same subfolder
rules.rule: Name individual task files `task<N>-<short-description>.md` and place them in the same phase subfolder as the overview.

rules.quote: GitHub Issues is the only task tracker.
rules.rule: Track all tasks in GitHub Issues, not in plan files or any other system.

rules.quote: task status, priority, and assignment live in GitHub
rules.rule: Record task status, priority, and assignment in GitHub Issues rather than in plan files.

rules.quote: Create the issue with `--title`, `--label`, `--milestone`, `--body` (or `--body-file`)
rules.rule: When creating a GitHub issue, set its title, label, milestone, and body.

rules.quote: **Add to GitHub Project board** (this is NOT automatic):
rules.rule: After creating a GitHub issue, add it to the GitHub Project board.

rules.quote: **Set the project status** (typically "Ready" for qa:ready issues, "Backlog" otherwise):
rules.rule: Set the project board status of a new issue to "Ready" if it is qa:ready, otherwise to "Backlog".

rules.quote: **Set the T-shirt size** on the project item (required — no size = not qa:ready):
rules.rule: Set a T-shirt size on the project item for every new issue, because an issue without a size is not qa:ready.

rules.quote: Use `./scripts/add-to-board.sh <url> <status>` to add and set status
rules.rule: Use ./scripts/add-to-board.sh with the issue URL and status to add an issue to the board and set its status.

rules.quote: Always Use `--limit 100`
rules.rule: Always pass --limit 100 when running gh project item-list, since the default returns only 30 items.

rules.quote: `Closes #N` in PRs is fine
rules.rule: Use `Closes #N` in pull request descriptions to link and auto-close the related issue.

rules.quote: Check GitHub Issues for highest-priority unassigned issue in current milestone
rules.rule: Select the highest-priority unassigned issue in the current milestone as the next task.

rules.quote: Assign itself
rules.rule: Assign the selected issue to yourself before starting work on it.

rules.quote: create worktree branch
rules.rule: Create a worktree branch for the issue before implementing it.

rules.quote: Read acceptance criteria
rules.rule: Read the issue's acceptance criteria before implementing.

rules.quote: QA agent verifies all criteria met
rules.rule: Have the QA agent verify all acceptance criteria are met before a PR is opened.

rules.quote: Review agent checks code quality
rules.rule: Have the review agent check code quality before a PR is opened.

rules.quote: T-shirt size must be set on the project item
rules.rule: During issue quality review, verify the T-shirt size is set on the project item.

rules.quote: Every acceptance criterion must be verifiable
rules.rule: During issue quality review, verify every acceptance criterion is verifiable.

rules.quote: Edge cases covered (empty states, errors, mobile)
rules.rule: During issue quality review, verify edge cases such as empty states, errors, and mobile are covered.

rules.quote: E2e test scenario obvious from criteria
rules.rule: During issue quality review, verify the e2e test scenario is clear from the acceptance criteria.

rules.quote: No size = automatic FAIL
rules.rule: Fail an issue automatically during quality review if it has no T-shirt size.

rules.quote: do not apply qa:ready
rules.rule: Do not apply the qa:ready label to an issue that fails quality review.

rules.quote: Agent approves or sends back for revision
rules.rule: During issue quality review, either approve the issue or send it back for revision.

rules.quote: Reads issue acceptance criteria
rules.rule: During pre-PR verification, read the issue's acceptance criteria.

rules.quote: Checks each criterion has corresponding code/tests/behavior
rules.rule: During pre-PR verification, check that each acceptance criterion has corresponding code, tests, or behavior.

rules.quote: Runs e2e and unit tests
rules.rule: During pre-PR verification, run the e2e and unit tests.

rules.quote: Gives PASS/FAIL with specifics
rules.rule: During pre-PR verification, give a PASS or FAIL verdict with specifics.

rules.quote: Never trust this file for per-issue status. Always query GitHub.
rules.rule: For per-issue status, do not rely on the task status file; query GitHub instead.

rules.quote: do not diary per-issue findings here
rules.rule: Do not record per-issue findings in the task status file.

rules.quote: Group screens must look and behave like Student screens.
rules.rule: Make Group screens look and behave like Student screens.

rules.quote: Operation-level inconsistencies are blocking, not polish
rules.rule: Treat operation-level inconsistencies between Group and Student screens as blocking issues, not polish.

rules.quote: I file, bots fix, I re-verify
rules.rule: During sprint close, file issues instead of fixing them inline, let the bots fix them, then re-verify the result.

rules.quote: add a "ship to Jordi?" check
rules.rule: When handling operation-level inconsistencies, add a "ship to Jordi?" check.

rules.quote: prod migration can only run AFTER the sprint merges + deploys
rules.rule: Run the production migration only after the sprint merges and deploys are complete.

rules.quote: run `--dry-run` in Azure mode first
rules.rule: Run the migration with --dry-run in Azure mode before running it for real.

rules.quote: don't trigger merge action
rules.rule: During the deploy freeze, do not trigger the merge action.

rules.quote: Revisit only if a real prod environment is later added.
rules.rule: Revisit the computer-vision.bicep cleanup only if a real production environment is later added.

rules.quote: Isaac review required before task creation
rules.rule: Get Isaac's pedagogy review before creating tasks for the Groups sprint.

rules.quote: Tasks are numbered sequentially within a phase.
rules.rule: Number tasks sequentially within each phase.

rules.quote: Branch naming: `task/t<N>-<short-description>`.
rules.rule: Name task branches task/t<N>-<short-description>.

rules.quote: When adding a service that reads from Key Vault, ensure the secret is provisioned.
rules.rule: When adding a service that reads from Key Vault, ensure its secret is provisioned in Key Vault.

rules.quote: push immediately for .claude/* and plan/* commits
rules.rule: Push immediately after committing changes to .claude/* and plan/* files.

rules.quote: UNVERIFIED result state replaces PASS(partial)
rules.rule: Use the UNVERIFIED result state for smoke tests instead of PASS(partial).

rules.quote: Each active sprint should have a story file at `plan/sprints/<slug>.md`.
rules.rule: For each active sprint, make sure a story file exists at plan/sprints/<slug>.md.

rules.quote: **When the sprint changes**, update the PM skill (`SKILL.md`) to point to the new story file.
rules.rule: When the sprint changes, update the PM skill (SKILL.md) to point to the new sprint's story file.

rules.quote: When the user asks about the status or progress of a running/completed agent (e.g., review-ui, qa-verify, review), the reasoning log is stored at:
rules.rule: When the user asks about the status or progress of a running or completed agent, check that agent's reasoning log, the JSONL transcript under ~/.claude/projects/<project-dir>/<session-id>/subagents/.

rules.quote: Identify the worktree the agent is running in (e.g., `task-t136-capitalize-dropdowns`)
rules.rule: To locate an agent's transcript, first identify the worktree the agent is running in.

rules.quote: Map it to the project directory: `~/.claude/projects/C--ws-PersonalOS-03-Workspace-langTeachSaaS--claude-worktrees-<worktree-name>/`
rules.rule: Map the agent's worktree name to the project directory ~/.claude/projects/C--ws-PersonalOS-03-Workspace-langTeachSaaS--claude-worktrees-<worktree-name>/ when locating its transcript.

rules.quote: The largest/most recently modified `.jsonl` file is typically the main agent transcript
rules.rule: When several .jsonl files exist in an agent's subagents/ folder, treat the largest or most recently modified one as the main agent transcript.

rules.quote: Must be read with `encoding='utf-8'` on Windows
rules.rule: When reading agent transcript files on Windows, open them with encoding='utf-8'.

rules.quote: **Quick status check command:**
rules.rule: To quickly check an agent's status, run the provided Python snippet against its transcript file and print the text of the last 20 lines' assistant messages.

rules.quote: ffmpeg path must be added to PATH explicitly since it was installed via winget and the bash shell doesn't pick it up automatically
rules.rule: When running Whisper transcription, add the ffmpeg binary directory to PATH explicitly in the process before importing whisper, because ffmpeg was installed via winget and the shell does not pick it up automatically.

rules.quote: clean up manually when saving
rules.rule: When saving Whisper transcription output containing non-ASCII characters (e.g., accented Spanish), clean up encoding issues manually before saving.

rules.quote: New Azure resource provisioned in `rg-langteach-dev`
rules.rule: Update reference_azure_resources.md when a new Azure resource is provisioned in the rg-langteach-dev resource group.

rules.quote: Resource renamed, deleted, or moved
rules.rule: Update reference_azure_resources.md when an Azure resource in the dev environment is renamed, deleted, or moved.

rules.quote: New environment added (staging, prod) — add a separate table
rules.rule: When a new environment (staging or prod) is added, add a separate table for it in reference_azure_resources.md.

rules.quote: if the RG is ever recreated, the suffix changes and this file must be updated
rules.rule: If the rg-langteach-dev resource group is ever recreated, update reference_azure_resources.md to reflect the changed Key Vault name suffix.

rules.quote: When the user asks to "check backlogs" or "review backlog logs", read all three files:
rules.rule: When the user asks to "check backlogs" or "review backlog logs", read all three backlog files (plan/code-review-backlog.md, plan/ui-review-backlog.md, plan/observed-issues.md).

rules.quote: At sprint end, the PM batches related items into `type:polish` or `type:tech-debt` GitHub issues.
rules.rule: At sprint end, batch related backlog items into `type:polish` or `type:tech-debt` GitHub issues.

rules.quote: Items are never converted one-to-one into issues.
rules.rule: Never convert backlog items one-to-one into GitHub issues.

rules.quote: Use Windows paths for Python (`C:\Users\Robert\...`), Unix paths for bash (`/tmp/...`)
rules.rule: When running Python code that reads or writes files, use Windows-style paths (e.g. C:\Users\Robert\...).

rules.quote: Use Windows paths for Python (`C:\Users\Robert\...`), Unix paths for bash (`/tmp/...`)
rules.rule: When running bash commands that use file paths, use Unix-style paths (e.g. /tmp/...).

rules.quote: Use `pdfminer.six` (installed) for text extraction
rules.rule: Use pdfminer.six to extract text from PDF attachments.

rules.quote: Extract base64 block from IMAP FETCH output, decode with `base64 -d`, save to file
rules.rule: To read a PDF attachment, extract the base64 block from the IMAP FETCH output, decode it with `base64 -d`, and save it to a file.

rules.quote: Fetch headers of recent emails (adjust range as needed)
rules.rule: When fetching email headers, adjust the FETCH message range as needed.

rules.quote: the working one is "Claude IMAP"
rules.rule: Authenticate to the Gmail bot account with the "Claude IMAP" app password, not the "pm-LangTeach" app password.

rules.quote: Read before reviewing or seeding any screen.
rules.rule: Read the screen behavior docs for a screen before reviewing or seeding that screen.

rules.quote: 1. **Quick Reference** -- mental model in under 20 lines, read this first
rules.rule: When reading a screen behavior doc, read its Quick Reference section first.

rules.quote: When a screen is revisited, update the existing file rather than creating a new one.
rules.rule: When revisiting a screen that already has a behavior doc, update the existing file rather than creating a new one.

rules.quote: When Vera reviews a new screen, she creates a new file here named `<screen>-behavior.md`.
rules.rule: When reviewing a new screen that has no behavior doc, create a new file named `<screen>-behavior.md` in the screen behavior docs folder.

rules.quote: If you're editing C# or TypeScript to change which exercises are valid at A1, the architecture is wrong. That should be JSON.
rules.rule: Do not change which exercises are valid at a given level by editing C# or TypeScript code; store that data in JSON config instead.

rules.quote: Any task that adds, removes, renames, or changes the semantics of a student profile field MUST update this document as part of the task.
rules.rule: When a task adds, removes, renames, or changes the meaning of a student profile field, update docs/student-profile-field-guide.md as part of that task.

rules.quote: If the doc and the code disagree, the doc is wrong and needs fixing.
rules.rule: When the field guide and the code disagree, treat the field guide as wrong and fix it.

rules.quote: When reviewing PRs or plans that touch the Student entity, check the field guide for alignment.
rules.rule: When reviewing PRs or plans that touch the Student entity, check them against the student profile field guide for alignment.

rules.quote: When creating issues for new student fields, reference the field guide definitions.
rules.rule: When creating issues for new student profile fields, reference the field guide's definitions.

rules.quote: treat as anonymous teacher
rules.rule: When feedback forwarded by Robert arrives by email, treat its content as coming from the anonymous teacher, not Robert.

rules.quote: feedback/raw/YYYY-MM-DD-anonymous-teacher-WAxxxx.txt
rules.rule: When saving a transcribed audio feedback file from this teacher, name it feedback/raw/YYYY-MM-DD-anonymous-teacher-WAxxxx.txt, using the date and the WhatsApp audio identifier.

rules.quote: feedback/raw/YYYY-MM-DD-anonymous-teacher-text.txt
rules.rule: When saving a text-message feedback file from this teacher, name it feedback/raw/YYYY-MM-DD-anonymous-teacher-text.txt, using the date.

rules.quote: Only contains things to fix — no status notes, no confirmations.
rules.rule: Keep the UI redesign feedback list file limited to actionable fixes; do not add status notes or confirmations to it.

rules.quote: When finishing a review session, batch issues as:
rules.rule: When finishing a UI review session, batch the resulting issues into seed/data fixes and screen-specific polish.

rules.quote: Seed/data fixes (area:infra, no code changes)
rules.rule: Create seed/data fix issues with the area:infra label and make no code changes for them.

rules.quote: Screen-specific polish (area:frontend per screen)
rules.rule: Create screen-specific polish issues with the area:frontend label, one per screen.

rules.quote: Hold off on creating issues for screens not yet reviewed.
rules.rule: Do not create issues for screens that have not yet been reviewed.

rules.quote: architect (Sophy)
rules.rule: Do not act as the architect persona when operating as Vera; leave architecture work to Sophy.

rules.quote: pedagogy (Isaac)
rules.rule: Do not act as the pedagogy persona when operating as Vera; leave teaching work to Isaac.

rules.quote: PM
rules.rule: Do not act as a product manager when operating as Vera.

rules.quote: code reviewer
rules.rule: Do not act as a code reviewer when operating as Vera.

rules.quote: works within the Academic Atelier (Stitch) system
rules.rule: Work within the Academic Atelier (Stitch) design system when giving design guidance.

rules.quote: will push boundaries when needed
rules.rule: Push beyond the Academic Atelier (Stitch) design system's constraints when needed.

rules.quote: ask Claude to add it here with a due date
rules.rule: When the user asks to set a reminder, add it to reminders.md with a due date.

rules.quote: mark it `done` or ask Claude to remove it
rules.rule: When the user asks to clear a reminder, mark it as done or remove it from reminders.md.

rules.quote: This file is read at the start of every `/pm` session — due or upcoming items are surfaced automatically
rules.rule: At the start of every /pm session, read reminders.md and surface any due or upcoming reminders.

rules.quote: Prepare a "here's what you can try" guide, not a "please test these things" checklist.
rules.rule: When preparing a readiness update for Jordi, write a "here's what you can try" guide, not a "please test these things" checklist.
